en: A sepia-toned studio portrait of a uniformed soldier framed in an oval vignette on a plain light background. The man, with a short mustache and neatly combed hair, wears a dark military tunic with metal buttons, shoulder straps, and breast pockets. The card edges are worn and slightly creased, resembling an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the front.
